mostWorthwhile.text: Covering the preserves was most worthwhile: it completed the goal and explained that the lid keeps dirt out without making an airtight seal.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the preserve jar was straightforward but offered little surprise on its own.

surprise.text: The cider jar completed the packing goal without a separate lid step, despite the chapter introduction mentioning lids.

arbitrary.text: Making a jar lid from planks and a glazed jar was somewhat unclear until the result showed what it produced.

continue.text: I might continue for another chapter: the practical details, especially the note about the lid, made the otherwise straightforward combinations more interesting.
